title: Partner registration application requirement
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-09-14
html:
MCN/ CAP

IF you are MCN/CAP, Please choose "Creator management" as Business category

Common Qualification information

Common qualification information will keep same for different categories . You only need to fill in one time while onboard. If you want to apply for the new category, common qualification information will be automatically reused and you don't need to fill in again. For certain corporate partners, TikTok Shop may also require information and supporting documents relating to the company's Ultimate Beneficial Owner(s) (UBOs), meaning the individual(s) who ultimately own or control the company. Where additional UBO information or documents are required, TikTok Shop will notify you through Partner Center and provide instructions on what needs to be submitted.

📌 Note: Brief company introduction; Main seller categories, Services three fields need to be filled in by default: 1. Company entity country language 2. Business market language 3. English

Field Format Remarks
Company introduction PDF Please upload a document about the basic introduction of the company, including such as the introduction of the company's business capabilities, team composition, successful cases, etc.; the document is in PDF format and should not exceed 30M
Brief company introduction Text Please briefly introduce the company's background description. The introduction will be displayed on behalf of the partner in other scenarios in the future, and it needs to be filled in properly; no more than 1000 characters
Main seller categories Text Provide a description of the industry type of your main service, such as clothing, shoes, bags, digital, etc. no more than 300 characters
Services Text Provide a description about the scope of your services, such as LIVE operation, short video operation, etc., no more than 300 characters
Contact Person Text No more than 50 characters
Email Text No more than 50 characters
Phone Number Text Country encoding and mobile number

Proof of partner operating capability

📌 Note: Proof of partner operating capability will be different according to company entity & business market & category. Requirements for operating capabilities：

Field Format Requirements
Creator accounts TT-handle Enter the TikTok usernames of creators you've signed.
Proof of signed creators Image (jpg/jpeg/png) Provide at least one document to prove that you have signed creators. This could be screenshots of the relevant terms and the signed and stamped signature page of a contract with a creator, for example.
Livestream capability Image (jpg/jpeg/png) Provide proof of your livestream capabilities, such as a screenshot of a TikTok LIVE lasting over 30 mins
Working environment Image (jpg/jpeg/png) Provide proof of your working environment, such as an image of your livestreaming studio or team.
Upload no more than 10 images and make sure they are under 10 MB and in jpg, png or jpeg format
Creator Cooperation Images (jpg/jpeg/png)
Provide at least one document to prove that you have signed creators. These could be screenshots of the relevant terms and the signed and stamped signature page of a contract with a creator, or screenshots of cooperated creator profile.
Upload no more than 10 images and make sure they are under 10 MB and in jpg, png or jpeg format

Requirements for operating ：

Field Format Requirement
Proof of sales image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Upload images proving your sales capabilities. This could be proof of your sales or e-commerce registration on TikTok Shop or another platform. Upload no more than 10 images and make sure they are under 10 MB and in jpg, png or jpeg format
Cooperated seller accounts TT-handle
> No more than 30		 Enter the TikTok username of one or more accounts you manage on behalf of sellers
Seller cooperation agreement image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide at least one document to prove that you provide services for sellers/brands. This could be screenshots of the service list and the signed and stamped signature page of a partnership agreement, for example.
Experience in Content image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide proof of your livestreaming capabilities, such as a screenshot of a TikTok LIVE lasting over 30 mins
Working environment image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide proof of your working environment, such as an image of your livestreaming studio or team.Upload no more than 10 images and make sure they are under 10 MB and in jpg, png or jpeg format

TikTok Shop seller recruitment records		 PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Provide the list of merchants you assist with on-boarding into the TikTok Shop (provide the corresponding company name and Shop ID);

Showcase of livestream training		 image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide sales data of livestreaming cases, including screenshots of cooperated shops and accounts. You can provide a single account with GMV over 5,000 USD or multiple accounts with total GMV over 14,000 USD in the past 30 days (based on system data)
Showcase of livestream operations image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide a livestreaming case of a single account with GMV over 1,000 USD in one livestream session. You need to also include the cooperated brand shop information, account usernames and sales screenshots.
Showcase of short video production and operations image（jpg/jpeg/png）
> No more than 10 images, the maximum size is 10M		 Provide a short video case with GMV over 1,000 USD in the past 30 days. You need to also include the cooperated brand shop information, account usernames and sales screenshots.
Showcase of TikTok Shop seller recruitment PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please provide three TikTok Shop seller recruitment cases with detailed information, including the recruitment location, posters, number of attendees and photos.
Proof of experience in ecommerce seller training PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please provide a previous seller training case with location, training content, number of cooperated sellers, and photos of the training session.
Provide proof of 1 training session in history (including the location of the training session, matching host resources, number of successful cooperative merchants, and photos of the training session);
Proof of experience in livestream planning PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please provide a livestream plan, including livestreaming production crew and campaign plans.
Training material PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please Upload the training material of the training session.
Proof of experience in livestream performance analysis PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please provide a livestream or shop data analysis report.
Cooperated TikTok accounts TT account Provide 3 TikTok accounts with at least 1,000 followers you've cooperated with
Livestream crew resources PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Provide proven certificate of your live host/operator resources.
· You can provide the agreement with the resource provider. The main party of the agreement must be your company, and the service provided is consistent with the service scope you're registering with. The agreement must be signed and sealed.
· Or you can provide the certificate to prove that your company has your own talent pool. You can provide a service scope for reference.
Proof of talent pool PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Provide a list of over 30 hosts/operators.
Proof of service category on TikTok Shop Partner Center image（jpg/jpeg/png） Provide proof of service category qualifications.
· To apply for the "Brand Integrated Operation" or "Operation Consulting and Guidance" or “Operation Side-by-Side Support”category, you need to provide screenshots to prove that your company was registered under the "Short Livestream management "and "LIVE Management "categories.
· To apply for the "Shop On-boarding Service" category, you need to provide screenshots to prove that your company was registered under "Operation Consulting"and "Operation Consulting and Guidance" category.
TikTok Shop seller recruitment records PDF
> The maximum size is 10M		 Please provide a signed onboarding service agreement with seals of the parties. The main party of the agreement must be your company, and the service provided must be consistent with the service scope you're registering with.
Provide a successfully signed on-boarding agreement (the main body of the contract must be consistent with the enterprise applying for the service provider, and the cooperation content is in line with the requirements, with the corresponding seal of both parties);
Proof of sales and tutoring materials image（jpg/jpeg/png） provide screenshots of seller sales data in their system (includes GMV and Orders) OR screenshots of other platforms (shopee, lazada, douyin) official websites where you can proof company identification of trainers or teachers.
Examples of tutoring materials （ppt.pdf.doc.video) provide a session of tutoring material, about how to cooperate in TikTok. PPT/PDF should be above 20 slides, document should be above 4 pages, video should be longer than 5 mins.
